component.name: cAInary
component.summary: See what your AI coding tools track and send

description.p: cAInary shows what your AI tools, and the device monitoring around them, track and send, and where it goes. It covers Claude Code and Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot, and reports policies your organization enforces, telemetry exporters, hooks, proxies and vendor defaults.

The tray icon shows the worst level found. A popup lists one row per tool, and a Details window shows every finding with its source file, the exact keys and a link to the vendor documentation. cAInary notifies you when a later scan adds or raises a finding.
cAInary only reads files. It never uses the network and never changes your configuration.
